title: RankUp
description: A Fabric mod adding RPG gear ranks and attribute modifiers to weapons, tools, and armor.
body:
🌟 RankUp: The Ultimate RPG Gear Overhaul
  RankUp brings a deep, data-driven progression system to Minecraft 1.21.10. Tired of every Diamond Sword feeling the same? With
  RankUp, every item is a unique artifact with its own tier, randomized attributes, and legendary potential.

  📈 The 7-Tier Ranking System
  Every piece of Armor, Tool, and Weapon (including the new Mace!) is automatically assigned a rank when it enters your inventory.
   * Rank EX (Mythical): The pinnacle of power. Features a radiant Aqua Aura and End Rod particles.
   * Rank SS (Legendary): High-voltage Golden Spark visuals and elite stat pools.
   * Rank S (Epic): Massive performance boosts and unique utility.
   * Rank A, B, C, D: Standard tiers that scale your gear from "Basic" to "Powerful."

  ---

  ⚔️ Advanced Attribute System
  Items "roll" randomized modifiers from a massive positive pool. High-rank items get more modifiers and higher values!
   * Melee & Tools: Bonus Attack Damage, Attack Speed, Critical Chance, Knockback, and Mining Speed.
   * Ranged (Bows/Crossbows): Bonus Ranged Damage, faster Projectile Velocity, and Spread Reduction for perfect accuracy.
   * Utility: Extra Max Health (Hearts), Armor Toughness, Luck, and Step Height.
   * Mace Specials: Flat Smash Damage bonuses and Smash Multipliers that stack with your fall distance for astronomical damage.

  ---

  🛡️ Legendary Set Bonuses
  Equipping a full matching set of Ranked Armor (Head, Chest, Legs, Feet) unlocks powerful passive abilities:
   * Full Rank S Set: Permanent Night Vision and Speed I.
   * Full Rank SS Set: Strength I, Resistance I, Fire Resistance, and Speed II.
   * Full Rank EX Set: CREATIVE FLIGHT.
       * Balance: You have a 5-minute flight battery. Once exhausted, the armor enters a 5-minute cooldown before flight can be
         used again. (Energy recharges slowly while standing on the ground!)

  ---

  🔨 Anvil Rerolling (Mace Only)
  The Mace is rare, and we respect your grind. If you get a bad roll on your Mace, you can reset it!
   * The Recipe: Combine any Ranked Mace with an Ominous Trial Key in an Anvil.
   * The Result: Clears all ranks and attributes, allowing the Mace to "re-roll" a brand new set of stats the moment you pick it
     up.
   * Cost: 10 XP Levels per reroll.

  ---

  🌀 The Fusion Table (Upgrading)
  Don't throw away your old gear! Use the Smithing Table to evolve your items to the next rank:
   * Rank A + Rank A (+ Netherite Block) ➔ Rank S
   * Rank S + Rank S (+ Netherite Block) ➔ Rank SS
   * Rank SS + Rank SS (+ Heavy Core) ➔ Rank EX
   * Bonus: Fusing items merges their random attributes and applies a 50% Power Boost to all stats when reaching Rank EX!

  ---

  👾 Elite Mobs & Loot
  The world is more dangerous now. Zombies, Skeletons, and Pillagers have a chance to spawn as Elite Variants.
   * They carry Ranked weapons and armor.
   * They have significantly more Health and deal more Damage.
   * Defeating them is the best way to farm high-rank gear and rare materials.

  ---

  📥 Technical Specs
   * Version: Minecraft 1.21.10 (Fabric)
   * Requires: Fabric API (0.135.0+1.21.10)
   * Performance: Highly optimized server-side logic and lightweight client-side particles.

  Developed by Vyom. MIT License. Perfect for RPG and Adventure Modpacks!

  ---
